about.title: ABOUT ME
about.subtitle: Hi there, I'm Riddhi!
bioParagraphs: I am a BSc Information Technology graduate from the University of Mumbai, seeking an entry-level role in SQL, Web Development, Java, or Manual Testing to apply my technical skills and grow professionally.
Highly adaptable, quick to learn, and details-oriented, I enjoy building clean web interfaces, writing structured SQL queries, and ensuring software quality through meticulous manual testing.

skillsTitle: A toolkit for building reliable software.
skillsSubtitle: Foundation in web technology, SQL databases, Java programming, and manual testing methodologies.

caseStudies.title: EXERCOACH GYM
caseStudies.platforms: Web Technology, HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript, Live Website
caseStudies.goal: Develop a high-impact, modern, and fully responsive website to establish the gym's online presence, showcase training programs, and drive membership registrations.
caseStudies.approach: Designed and developed the website exercoachgym.com from scratch as a freelance developer. Structured class directories, contact integrations, and coach rosters with a performance-first approach for instantaneous page loads.

caseStudies.title: AUTOMATED METER READING
caseStudies.goal: Automate utility meter reading to eliminate manual entry errors, reduce processing time, and speed up billing operations.
caseStudies.approach: Developed a web-based application that integrates a webcam to capture real-time images of analog/digital utility meters. Implemented Tesseract OCR (Optical Character Recognition) to extract numerical digits from the images and store them in a database.

caseStudies.title: E-COMMERCE HOMEPAGE
caseStudies.goal: Build a fully responsive and visually appealing homepage simulating real-world e-commerce features and product listings.
caseStudies.approach: Designed a responsive storefront showcasing electronics and groceries. Utilized Bootstrap's grid and components for layout flexibility, added dynamic location mapping, navigation components, and robust media integrations.
